headline: Jamaat alleges BNP-AL attack on anti-extortion protest in Gulistan
summary: Jamaat-e-Islami claims activists and traders were attacked with rods and knives, while police describe the incident as a brief scuffle.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami leaders and activists allegedly came under attack during a protest procession against extortion and illegal occupation in Dhaka's Gulistan on Saturday.
The incident occurred beneath the Fulbaria Flyover around 5:00 PM, where Jamaat claims 15 to 20 traders and activists were injured.
Abdus Sattar Sumon of Jamaat alleged that local BNP activists and members of the banned Awami League attacked the gathering with knives, iron rods, and sticks.
Jamaat further alleged that BNP activists had recently taken control of Nagar Plaza Market by vandalising CCTV cameras and removing computers.
However, Bangshal Police Station OC AKM Mahfuzul Haque provided a different account, stating there was no organised attack, only a brief scuffle.
Police believe the gathering was an attempt by Jamaat to establish control over the market, which is currently overseen by a committee backed by Jamaat.
The OC stated that around 200 BNP supporters were present and vigilant in the area when the two groups faced off.
Police denied reports of stabbings or multiple casualties, claiming only one Jamaat activist sustained minor injuries during the altercation.
caption:
Clash in Gulistan: Jamaat alleges a violent attack by BNP and AL activists, but police report only a 'brief scuffle'.

Jamaat-e-Islami leaders and activists allegedly came under attack during a protest procession against extortion and illegal occupation in Dhaka's Gulistan on Saturday.

The incident occurred beneath the Fulbaria Flyover around 5:00 PM, where Jamaat claims 15 to 20 traders and activists were injured.

Abdus Sattar Sumon of Jamaat alleged that local BNP activists and members of the banned Awami League attacked the gathering with knives, iron rods, and sticks.

Jamaat further alleged that BNP activists had recently taken control of Nagar Plaza Market by vandalising CCTV cameras and removing computers.

However, Bangshal Police Station OC AKM Mahfuzul Haque provided a different account, stating there was no organised attack, only a brief scuffle.

Police believe the gathering was an attempt by Jamaat to establish control over the market, which is currently overseen by a committee backed by Jamaat.

The OC stated that around 200 BNP supporters were present and vigilant in the area when the two groups faced off.

Police denied reports of stabbings or multiple casualties, claiming only one Jamaat activist sustained minor injuries during the altercation.

headline: Man detained for raping mentally ill woman in Comilla
summary: The suspect was arrested in Borura Upazila after CCTV footage of the assault on a woman sleeping on a sidewalk went viral on social media.
details: A man has been detained by police in Comilla's Sadar South Upazila for allegedly raping a mentally ill woman. The arrest took place Saturday night in Borura Upazila following an investigation into CCTV footage circulating on social media.
